answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a horizon bet on surviving 42 epochs of grading, and every garden settlement recomputes the reef schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 42 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 3 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
